description: A faceted product filter bar composed from the SvGrid UI kit in Svelte 5: SvAutoComplete searches product names, SvButtonGroup picks the category, SvTagsInput adds tags, SvSlider sets a price range, SvSwitchButton limits to in-stock items and SvDropDownList chooses the sort, filtering a live product list as each control changes. Every control is also a SvGrid cell editor.

faq.question: How does the list react to the controls?
faq.answer: Each control writes to its own $state, and the visible products are one $derived that applies the search, category, tags, price range and stock flag in sequence, then sorts.

faq.question: How is the price range bound?
faq.answer: SvSlider with the range prop reports a [min, max] tuple through onChange; min, max and step set the track, and the derived filter keeps products inside the tuple.

faq.question: Can the tags be restricted to known values?
faq.answer: Yes. The demo filters the SvTagsInput value against the known tag list in onChange, so an unknown tag is dropped as it is typed.
